assumptions: 'Deployment configuration' for MARKET_API_URL means the process environment, accessed through the existing handle(path, query, environ) signature (os.environ-compatible mapping); deploy/service.json contains only {"replicas":2}, has no MARKET_API_URL key, and deploy/ is outside the writable paths, so it cannot be modified.

The price value continues to come from the configured market service; in the current stub implementation it is passed through from the query/context, and null prices must be preserved as None in the 200 response.
'Invalid symbol' means missing, non-string, or blank-after-strip symbol; anything else with a configured, available service returns 200.

The pinned dependency revision (requirements.lock, sha256:1c0f31859f4840feabe0b2fface9c6de5fee7fbfe3e110da72d0bd586d55a09e) stays byte-identical; the implementation uses only the Python 3.11 standard library.
risks: Baseline tests reference '/quote' and will fail until updated to '/api/quote' in the same change; the route rename is a breaking change for any existing '/quote' consumer, but the intent explicitly requires /api/quote.

Contradiction/unresolved choice: the intent says MARKET_API_URL comes from 'deployment configuration', but the only deployment file (deploy/service.json) lacks the key and is read-only; the plan resolves this by reading the environment, matching the baseline behavior and tests.

The 503 'service unavailable' path can only be fully exercised for the unset/empty MARKET_API_URL case in unit tests; genuine upstream unavailability depends on the runtime service and is out of scope for the stdlib-only stub.
Compilation (py_compile) alone does not demonstrate behavior; the unit acceptance command must also pass for this exact candidate, with no baseline failure waived.

steps.description: Edit src/app.py (only file under the writable src/** root). Change the route guard from '/quote' to '/api/quote', keeping the 404 {'error': 'not found'} fallback for other paths. Keep reading the symbol from the symbol query parameter; return 422 with {'error': 'invalid symbol'} when symbol is missing, non-string, or blank after strip(). Read MARKET_API_URL from deployment configuration via the environ mapping (os.environ-compatible, as the baseline handle(path, query, environ) signature already does); return 503 {'error': 'service unavailable'} when it is unset/empty or the configured service is unavailable. On success return status 200 with the flat object {'symbol': symbol, 'price': price}, preserving null prices (price: None must pass through unchanged). Keep the module dependency-free (stdlib only) so the pinned requirements.lock (sha256:1c0f31859f4840feabe0b2fface9c6de5fee7fbfe3e110da72d0bd586d55a09e) remains untouched and valid.
steps.title: Implement /api/quote route in src/app.py

steps.description: Edit tests/test_app.py (only file under tests/). Update the existing QuoteTest cases to call handle with '/api/quote' instead of '/quote': test_quote asserts a valid quote returns (200, {'symbol': 'ABC', 'price': 12.5}) with MARKET_API_URL configured; test_invalid asserts a blank symbol (' ') returns status 422 with body {'error': 'invalid symbol'}; test_missing_price asserts a null price is preserved as None in the 200 response. Add a case asserting that a missing/unset MARKET_API_URL yields 503, and optionally that a non-/api/quote path yields 404, to lock the routing contract. Keep the suite runnable via the declared unit command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_app.py -v.
steps.title: Update unit tests for the /api/quote contract

steps.description: Edit README.md (the declared documentation root) to document the new contract: GET /api/quote?symbol=ABC; MARKET_API_URL read from deployment configuration (environment); 200 returns flat {symbol, price} with null prices preserved; blank or invalid symbols return 422 with {error: "invalid symbol"}; an unavailable configured service returns 503. Remove/replace the stale '/quote' reference.
steps.title: Document the /api/quote contract in README.md

steps.description: Execute both declared acceptance commands for this exact candidate: 'unit' = python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_app.py -v (demonstrates behavior: valid quote, blank symbol 422, null price preservation, 503) and 'compile' = python3 -m py_compile src/app.py (syntax validity only; not sufficient alone). Both must pass; no baseline failure is waived. Do not modify requirements.lock, deploy/service.json, or any path outside src/**, tests/**, README.md.

document.summary: Baseline: src/app.py exposes handle(path, query, environ) serving '/quote' with symbol validation (422), MARKET_API_URL lookup from environ (503 when unset), and a flat {symbol, price} 200 response that already preserves null prices. tests/test_app.py covers valid quote, blank symbol, and null price against '/quote'. README.md documents '/quote'. The task renames the route to /api/quote and requires the full contract (200 flat object with null-price preservation, 422 {error: "invalid symbol"} for blank/invalid symbols, 503 for unavailable configured service), README documentation, and unit coverage of valid quotes, blank symbols, and null prices. Plan: (1) update src/app.py to route /api/quote while keeping the environ-based MARKET_API_URL configuration read and null-price passthrough; (2) update tests/test_app.py to the new path and add a 503 case; (3) rewrite README.md to document the contract; (4) verify with both declared acceptance commands: unit (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_app.py -v) and compile (python3 -m py_compile src/app.py).
